title: The King of
tagline: LaTeX editor, PDF annotations, paper discovery, and AI coding agents — all in one app.

messages.main: The complete AI research platform. LaTeX editor with live PDF preview, annotations, reference library, and paper discovery.
messages.sub: Write papers with bidirectional SyncTeX, highlight PDFs in 5 colors, organize your library, and discover related work. Free Overleaf + Zotero alternative.

messages.main: Select any text and ask AI. In your PDF or LaTeX document, highlight a passage and get instant explanations, improvements, or translations.
messages.sub: Claude, Gemini, or local models at your fingertips. The fastest way to understand complex papers or improve your writing.

messages.main: 30+ professional templates ready to use. NeurIPS, CVPR, Nature, PhD Thesis, Academic CV, Conference Posters, and more.
messages.sub: Stop fighting with LaTeX formatting. Smart placeholders, package browser, equation preview, and BibTeX cleanup tools built in.

messages.main: The ultimate vibe kanban platform for agentic coding. Free, 100% local wrapper for Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and more.
messages.sub: Orchestrate parallel AI agents with visual workflows, git worktrees, and ralph loop support. The best Cursor and Windsurf alternative.

messages.main: AI that follows your rules. Define coding standards, review criteria, and agentic workflows your agents must follow.
messages.sub: Every change tracked, every decision logged. Full visibility with vibe kanban boards and audit trails.

messages.main: Full control over every line of code. Review, approve, or reject suggestions made by your AI agents with a powerful diff view.
messages.sub: Keep your code quality high. Your agents propose changes, you maintain the final authority. Perfectly integrated into your development flow.
